name: China

election.name: 2023 presidential election by the 14th National People's Congress

system.type: Indirect: the National People's Congress elects the president

wildFacts.text: All 2,952 NPC deputies present voted for Xi, with no abstentions or opposing votes.
Vice President Han Zheng was elected by the same 2,952-0 tally.
Xi's third term followed the NPC ending the two-term limit five years earlier.

notes: Officially reported: 2,952 votes to 0. There is no nationwide popular vote, so no turnout figure exists. Source: The Hindu.
